QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off." and "Enabling `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (or an ALT implementation) turns on the locks"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros and states that enabling them turns on the locking, which identifies them as the gating macros.
